excerpts.text: Stability of hypothetical AgIICl2 polymorphs under high pressure, revisited : a computational study A comparative computational study of stability of candidate structures for an as yet unknown silver dichloride AgCl2 is presented. It is found that all considered candidates have a negative enthalpy of formation, but are unstable towards charge transfer and decomposition into silver(I) chloride and chlorine within the DFT and hybrid DFT approaches in the entire studied pressure range.

Crystal Structure of the Solid Electrolyte(C5H5NH) Ag5I6 at -30{degrees}C. The crystal structure of pyridinium hexaiodopentaargentate, (C(5)H(5)NH) Ag(5)l(6), is unique among those of the halide and chalcogenide solid electrolytes in that face-sharing iodide octahedra as well as face-sharing tetrahedra and face-sharing between octahedra and tetrahedra provide the paths for silver ion transport.
